title: Edge-Based Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Autonomous FHWA Bridge Inspection Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2608.20372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) mandates that over 600,000 bridges in the United States be evaluated against the Recording and Coding Guide for the National Bridge Inventory (NBI). Manual compliance verification is labor-intensive, error-prone, and impractical in connectivity-limited field environments. This paper introduces BridgeGuard, a fully air-gapped agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for autonomous bridge inspection compliance. BridgeGuard integrates vector search over the FHWA Recording and Coding Guide with structured SQL queries against NBI tabular data, orchestrated by a stateful multi-step ReAct planning loop executing locally on commodity edge hardware. A section-aware chunking algorithm preserves hierarchical regulatory item boundaries, achieving 94.2% chunk integrity compared with 28.4% for naive fixed-size splitting. translated_title: 基于边缘的智能检索增强生成用于自主FHWA桥梁检查合规性
translated_abstract: 美国联邦公路管理局（FHWA）要求对全美超过60万座桥梁按照《国家桥梁清单（NBI）记录与编码指南》进行评估。手动合规性验证劳动密集、易出错，且在连通性受限的现场环境中不切实际。本文介绍了BridgeGuard，一个完全气隙隔离的智能检索增强生成（RAG）系统，用于自主桥梁检查合规性。BridgeGuard将基于FHWA记录与编码指南的向量搜索与针对NBI表格数据的结构化SQL查询相结合，由在商品边缘硬件上本地执行的有状态多步骤ReAct规划循环进行编排。一种章节感知的分块算法保留了层级监管项边界，实现了94.2%的分块完整性，而朴素固定大小分割仅为28.4%。在特拉华州2023年完整NBI清单（874座桥梁）和德克萨斯州部分数据上进行了评估。
tldr: BridgeGuard是一个完全离线运行的边缘智能RAG系统，通过结合向量搜索和SQL查询以及章节感知分块算法，显著提升了桥梁检查合规性验证的准确性和效率。
en_tdlr: BridgeGuard is a fully air-gapped edge-based agentic RAG system that combines vector search and SQL queries with a section-aware chunking algorithm to significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of bridge inspection compliance verification.
